Manual follow-ups (2):
  1. server/utils/journal.ts:3 `getAgent()` was removed. Use `loadAgent(name)` to load a discovered Agent Definition, and `runAgent()` or `streamAgent()` to run it.
  2. server/utils/journal.ts:3 `isBlobValue` is no longer exported from the Agent root. It was an internal helper; remove the import or copy what you need.

Notes:
  - `input.context.actor` and the `actor` field of Agent callbacks are gone. ViteHub reads only `invoker`, so an `actor` the codemod did not see no longer sets the caller.
